summary: Tested new Panchang & Festivals feature. Backend: Both /api/panchang/today and /api/festivals/upcoming endpoints working correctly with all required fields. Panchang returns tithi (name, index 1-30, paksha, progress), nakshatra (name, index 1-27, pada 1-4, progress), yoga (name, index 1-27, progress), vara (sanskrit, english, lord), sun_sign, moon_sign. Festivals returns date, name, description, days_until, weekday. Custom timezone works, invalid timezone returns 400, limit param clamped 1-20. Frontend: PanchangSection renders correctly with all data-testid attributes. Section appears between hero and pricing. All 12 new backend tests pass, 20 regression tests pass.

integration_issues.issue: Panchang/festivals data takes ~5-10 seconds to load on first visit, showing 'consulting the heavens...' loading state. This is expected behavior but could be improved with skeleton loading.

seed_data_creation: None - endpoints are public and use computed/static data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Panchang & Festivals feature fully tested. Key verifications: (1) GET /api/panchang/today returns live Swiss Ephemeris computed data with default Asia/Kolkata timezone, (2) Custom timezone via ?tz= param works, invalid tz returns 400, (3) GET /api/festivals/upcoming returns curated Hindu festivals 2026-2027, (4) limit param clamped 1-20, default 6, (5) Frontend PanchangSection loads data after ~5-10s, all data-testid attributes present, (6) Section positioned between hero and pricing on Landing page.
